content_analyzer.video_prompt: Analyze this video concisely (caveman style): 1. Is it a music cover or a vlogging video? 2. If music cover: name the song being covered (it might be a Bengali song[cite: 1]), list instruments used, and who is singing. 3. If vlogging: list the exact places/locations shown. Keep it ultra-short and factual.
content_analyzer.image_prompt: Analyze this image concisely: 1. Mood/Vibe. 2. Core themes. 3. Probable location/setting.

caption_generator.prompt:
Write 1 short, catchy social media caption based on this analysis. Output ONLY the caption text:
{analysis}

hashtag_generator.prompt:
Extract 5-8 trending tags based on this analysis. Output comma-separated keywords ONLY, no symbols:
{analysis}

location_generator.prompt:
Identify 1-3 best physical locations or contextual geotags to tag for this content. Output comma-separated names ONLY:
{analysis}
